what: ABS Consumer Price Index (dataflow CPI v2.0.0, current CPI, base Sep 2025=100): index numbers, original, weighted average of eight capital cities (REGION 50), quarterly, selected groups/classes
ABS Consumer Price Index (dataflow CPI v2.0.0): same classes, MONTHLY. Used only in the checks, to show that from Dec qtr 2025 the quarterly series are averages of the new monthly CPI
ABS Consumer Price Index (dataflow CPI v1.1.0, the former quarterly CPI, ends Sep qtr 2025): same key; used only to test the seam where ABS links the new monthly-based CPI onto the quarterly history
ABS CPI weights (dataflow CPI_WEIGHTS): percentage contribution to the All groups CPI, weighted average of eight capital cities, at each reweight (2018-Q3 to 2024-Q4)
ABS SDMX structure for dataflow CPI v2.0.0 (code lists: CL_CPI_INDEX labels, regions, measures)
ABS SDMX structure for dataflow CPI_WEIGHTS (code lists)

ABS Average Weekly Earnings (dataflow AWE): full-time adult average weekly ordinary time earnings (MEASURE 3), earnings (ESTIMATE_TYPE 1), persons (SEX 3), private and public (SECTOR 7), all industries, original, Australia, biannual (S1 = May, S2 = November), Nov 1994 onward
ABS SDMX structure for dataflow AWE (code lists)

ABS 6302.0 Average Weekly Earnings, Australia, May 2026, Table 3 (original, dollars); series A85002148L = Earnings; Persons; Full Time; Adult; Ordinary time earnings. Used to cross-check the API series
ABS Wage Price Index (dataflow WPI v1.2.0): quarterly index, total hourly rates of pay excluding bonuses, private and public, all industries, original, Australia, Sep qtr 1997 onward
ABS SDMX structure for dataflow WPI (code lists)

ABS 6416.0 Residential Property Price Indexes: Eight Capital Cities, Dec 2021 (final release), Table 2 Established House Price Index; series A83728456R = weighted average of eight capital cities, original, Mar qtr 2002 to Dec qtr 2021
ABS 6416.0 Dec 2021, Table 8 Established House Price Index, pre-September quarter 2005 methodology; series A2333613R = weighted average of 8 capital cities, Jun qtr 1986 to Jun qtr 2005
ABS Total Value of Dwellings (dataflow RES_DWELL_ST): mean price of residential dwellings, Australia, quarterly, $'000, Sep qtr 2011 onward (all dwellings incl. land; not quality adjusted)
FRED series AHETPI: US average hourly earnings of production and nonsupervisory employees, total private (BLS CES), SA. Used only for the same-window US comparison
FRED series CUSR0000SAD: US CPI-U durables, SA (the paper's Figure 5 durables deflator). Used only for the same-window US comparison
FRED series CPIUFDNS: US CPI-U food, NSA (the paper's Figure 5 food deflator). Used only for the same-window US comparison
FRED series CPIENGNS: US CPI-U energy, NSA (the paper's Figure 5 energy deflator). Used only for the same-window US comparison
FRED series CUSR0000SAH1: US CPI-U shelter, SA (the paper's Figure 5 shelter deflator). Used only for the same-window US comparison
FRED series CUUR0000SEHA: US CPI-U rent of primary residence, NSA (like-for-like with the ABS CPI Rents class). Used only for the same-window US comparison
